displayProperties.name: Unrelenting

tooltipNotifications.displayString:
These trait columns can be enhanced once requirements have been met:

• To upgrade left column traits, Tier 2 weapon enhancements are required.
• To upgrade right column traits, Tier 3 weapon enhancements are required.

ddc.name: Unrelenting
ddc.rawHTML:
241
Unrelenting
Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress through Weapon Kills within 5 seconds of each:
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elites/Minibosses/Bosses = 100% | Guardians = 67%.

Begins Health Regeneration and restores 65 ↑70 HP.
